title: Grateful Dead Live at Warfield Theater on 1982-02-17
source: Recorded, Transferred and Mastered by N. Hoey; 2 Nakamichi CM 300 > Sony TC D-5m (Dolby B)(Maxell UDXL-IIS 90) (Lower Loge Section 3 Row AA Seats 3-7) Nakamichi Dragon (Dolby B decoded) > TC Electronics Konnekt8 (A/D conversion)(transferred @ 88.2/24-resampled to 44.1k/dithered to 16 bit) > Apple OS X 10.5.8 (Peak 6 editing-resampling-dithering) > Xact

ai_review.summary: Solid recording captures a loose, high‑energy performance that stays strong through the second set.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise the show for its well‑played and loose feel, noting that it remains engaging at least halfway through the second set. The tape is commended as a good job by the source creator, with no reported sound issues, making it an enjoyable listen.

ai_rating.rationale: Two strongly positive reviews (4 and 5 stars) highlight good musical performance and a satisfactory recording; limited sample size keeps confidence low.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific sound issues mentioned; reviewer thanks the maker for a well‑done job, implying clear enough audio.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Consistently lively throughout, with the second set maintaining the momentum noted by reviewers.
